digest.title: Dell earnings call 2026-11-26

architecture_signals.enterprise_ai_use_case: agentic AI, inference, recursive learning, KV cache, multimodal workflows
architecture_signals.agent_product_usage_disclosure: 100,000 agents spun up daily across Dell organization; doubling in 90 days
architecture_signals.custom_silicon_named: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, AMD MI400
architecture_signals.architecture_freetext: Dell shipping majority of new orders on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72; agentic workloads driving CPU server demand for harness/orchestration; KV cache, multimodal, recursive learning expanding storage and traditional server TAM

key_quotes: Demand continues to exceed supply; gap between component supply and end-user demand continues to widen.
Agentic AI driving 10x productivity improvements; agents spun up 100,000 daily across organization.
Memory demand way ahead of supply; DRAM wafer capacity shift to HBM crunch continues into 2027.

indicator_deltas.summary: Demand-supply gap explicitly widening; inventory language absent in both calls but current call emphasizes gap expansion vs. prior's constraint flagging.
indicator_deltas.prior_quote: Demand outstripped supply. Demand was even greater than results published.
indicator_deltas.current_quote: Demand continues to exceed supply; gap between component supply and end-user demand continues to widen.

indicator_deltas.summary: No demand destruction signals in either call; current call reports accelerating agentic adoption (100k agents daily) and guidance raises, contradicting destruction thesis.
indicator_deltas.current_quote: Agentic AI driving 10x productivity improvements; agents spun up 100,000 daily across organization.

indicator_deltas.summary: New indicator added in current call; language on 200 GW power buildout and 87x token growth through 2030 signals parabolic capex trajectory.
indicator_deltas.current_quote: Power build out forecast gw: 200; token growth forecast through 2030 multiplier: 87.

indicator_deltas.summary: New indicator added in current call; no plateau signals present; instead guidance extends through 2030 with continued growth.
indicator_deltas.current_quote: Memory demand way ahead of supply; DRAM wafer capacity shift to HBM crunch continues into 2027.

indicator_deltas.summary: Current call names specific NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and AMD MI400 as majority-shipped configs, confirming HBM as captive design standard vs. prior's generic disaggregated architecture language.
indicator_deltas.current_quote: Dell shipping majority of new orders on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72; custom silicon named: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, AMD MI400.

language_dropped: Spotty CPU shortages (CPU constraint language from Q3 absent in Q4)
Demand-supply gap phrased as 'demand was even greater than results published' — Q4 shifts to focus on widening gap and component supply constraints rather than demand surprise
Generic consolidation ratios (17G, 18G) with multiples — no longer specified in Q4
language_added: 100,000 agents spun up daily across Dell organization; doubling in 90 days (new agent deployment velocity metric)
Agentic AI driving 10x productivity improvements (new quantified benefit claim)
NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and AMD MI400 named as specific majority-shipped configs (prior call had no named accelerators)
Recursive learning, multimodal workflows (new workload use-case categories beyond agentic, inference, KV cache)
Memory demand way ahead of supply; DRAM wafer capacity shift to HBM crunch continues into 2027 (escalated memory constraint language and 2027 extension)
87x token growth through 2030; 200 GW power buildout forecast (new large-scale projections)
Agentic servers asp multiple: 2.0x (new pricing power metric)
